newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backed spreads narrow in light trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backed spreads narrow in light trade.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities dipped with Treasuries Monday, but yield spreads again narrowed modestly in light trading, mortgage-market experts said.
Late in the day, mortgages were off 1/32 to 9/32 overall while comparable Treasuries were down 6/32 to 10/32. Yield spreads narrowed a few basis points from Friday's close.
Traders described market activity as mostly quiet but punctuated by brief spurts of retail buying.
"Its been completely dead, but there was some buying earlier," one trader said.
NationsBank Corp, which was said to have sold about $2 billion of mortgage paper in the past couple of weeks, was not seen in the market, traders said.
Late on Monday, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was off 8/32 at 99-11/32, yielding 104 basis points aver the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac issues were 8/32 lower as well, at 99-08/32 and 99-13/32, respectively.
The 10-year Treasury note had slipped 10/32 to 6.67 percent.
